topic: why paying off and closing your last remaining loan or credit card can actually make your credit score DROP -- a real, counterintuitive mechanic almost nobody expects, about credit mix and account age
title: Why Paying Off Debt Can Hurt Your Credit Score
description:
You did the right thing and paid off your last loan. So why did your credit score drop? It's a counterintuitive part of the credit scoring model that punishes you for two specific reasons.
